name: 76209 · Denton, TX
findings: ZIP 76209 (Denton) has 68 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76209 (Denton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 76209 (Denton) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).
